facts.text: Evan expresses gratitude for the support and love from his family, stating that they bring happiness and are always there for him.

evidence.quote: For sure, Sam. That's what makes family so special. They bring so much love and happiness. It's great having their support and knowing they're always there for us.
Yeah, definitely, Evan. We both have amazing families that are always there for us. Always a blessing.

facts.text: Sam agrees with Evan, emphasizing that family is everything and that they bring love, happiness, and unwavering support.

evidence.quote: Yeah Sam, that means a lot to me. Our bond just keeps getting stronger and it brings such a good feeling to our lives. Family really is everything.
Agree, Evan! Family is everything - they bring so much love and happiness. They're always there for us no matter what.

facts.text: Evan mentions that his family is a real blessing and that he doesn't know what he'd do without them.

evidence.quote: Yeah, Sam. Our families give us so much joy, support, and love. They're a real blessing! I don't know what I'd do without them.

facts.text: Sam states that his family has been his rock through everything and that he doesn't know what he'd do without them.

evidence.quote: Hey, Evan. My family has been my rock through everything. Don't know what I'd do without them.
